videos.title: Matrix multiplication as composition | Chapter 4, Essence of linear algebra
videos.filter_reason: From the acclaimed 3Blue1Brown series, this video masterfully explains matrix multiplication as a composition of transformations, providing the fundamental intuition for why the order of operations (TRS) is critical.
